main_text.p: Bubulus] Bubulum lac, Col. Bovillus, Plin. Boarium forum, Fest.
Bucca] Rictus. Rostrum, de homine, Plaut.
Bucco] Buccis fluentibus homo, Cic. Bucculentus, Plaut, Masticus, Fest. Vid. Tubicen.
Buccina] Cornu, Var. Triton, Buccini concha excavata, perforata sonat, Higin. Tuba, in variis usibus, Sen. Quint. Classicum, (extra bellum) Liv. Classico ad concionem vocat.

Buccinare] Inflare buccinam, Var. Canere tubâ, Virg. Dare signum tubâ, Cæs. Occanere tubas, cornua, Tac. Implere cornu bombis, Pers. Terribilem sonitum ære canoro increpuit, Virg. Stridulum aërem elidere lituis. Concipere classica cornu, Lucan. Æneatorum occentu signo dato, Ammian. Occinere, Diomed.
Buccinator] Cornicen, Iuv. Cornuarius, Fest. Flator, Id. Tubicen, Sen. Liticen, Enn. Non. Æneator, Suet. Classicines, Varr. Incentor tubarum, Ammian.
Bulimea] Canina appetentia, Gorr. Milvina orexis, ex Plaut. Camer. Magna fames, Gell. Phagedæna, Plin. Milvina appetentia, Turneb.
(2) Libris affixus globus] Umbilicus librorum, Hor. Martial.
Bura] Dentale, Virg. Dens aratri, Var. Buris, Virg. Curvum aratri, Var.
main_text.head: C.
main_text.p: Cachinnari] Risu crepare, Cic. Crassum ridere, Pers. Dissilire risu, Sen. Majore cachinno concuti. Pulmonem risu agitare, Iuv. Ridere ore Catuli Gallicani, Catul. Emori risu.

page.notes: The first word "Cccare" is printed with a large initial C; read as "Ccare" (Accare), the initial letter is uncertain and marked here as printed. Page number and running head read from the scan.
